a.lede: On this day in 2006, Nvidia released the legendary GeForce 8800 GTX graphics card and it is celebrating the event with a very demanding (but free) interactive Steam demo.
a.title: Nvidia released its 8800 GTX GPU 20 years ago today, celebrates with Steam game homage

b.lede: With the announcement of its M6, Apple is stepping into a new generation of its processors. Here's why it still can't compete with NVIDIA GPUs.
b.title: Why Apple's M6 Chip Can't Hold Its Own Against Any NVIDIA GPU
